exclude.web/playwright-report: Playwright HTML report output; not read by the command
exclude.web/test-results: Playwright per-test output; not read by the command

audit.input_rationale: make test-ui runs npm ci (resolved dependency tree in web/node_modules, hashed in the worktree, from the committed lockfile), npm run build (tsc and vite build into internal/httpapi/dashboard, tracked and committed at this head so the rebuild reproduces it), then Playwright: the selected AC-3.2 test runs in the built-dashboard project against vite preview serving the freshly built internal/httpapi/dashboard (a fresh Vite dev server also starts for the dev-server project) with the Chromium build under PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH (inventoried) and the Node runtime under ~/.nvm (inventoried). BOARD_MAP_CPU_THROTTLE=4 makes web/tests/board-map.spec.ts:777 apply Chrome DevTools Protocol CPU throttling to the page. No database, network service, or credential is used; the specs mock every /v1 read. Output directories web/playwright-report and web/test-results are excluded and never read. PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME names a JSON report file in the task's durable state directory, outside the worktree, which records each run's elapsed annotation; the command writes it and never reads it.
audit.git_rationale: Not audited for Git independence; the record is fresh execution at the committed head and is not reused across commits.
